title: selaginella rupestris
intro: Selaginella rupestris, commonly known as the rock spike moss or mountain spikemoss, is a species of evergreen, perennial plant that belongs to the family Selaginellaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antiseptic and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella rupestris are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
